images.name: 유려한 초승달 장궁
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium high-fantasy MMORPG bow concept, for the noble Twilight of the Blue Moon collection. Exactly ONE BOW, shown alone, upright, full length, portrait 2:3 composition, 1024x1536. The single bow fills approximately 88% of image height with 6% safe margin above and below; use its elegant sweep to fill the portrait naturally, no excessive empty space. Near-front three-quarter product presentation, crisp high-resolution material details and complete clear silhouette. Plain uniform very dark midnight-navy background. Design a NEW independent bow from scratch, not a crop of a multi-weapon sheet. PRIORITY: an unmistakable functional LONG BOW with long slender continuous upper and lower limbs, a clear human-sized central handgrip, tapered recurved tips, and one taut fine azure string running between both tip notches on the RIGHT of the grip. Keep the arrow and string paths open and the center grip usable. Elaborately beautiful but controlled asymmetry, noble sweeping curves and deliberate open spaces; jewelcraft integrated into the bow structure. Main material is saturated sapphire-blue translucent moonstone, deep cobalt crystal and luminous condensed blue moonlight, not ordinary metal painted blue. Clear brilliant blue lunar highlights against richly dark blue surfaces, restrained thin platinum and pale-gold seams, subtle star engraving. An unmistakable BLUE MOON motif is integrated coherently into the limbs, clearly visible but proportionate; no giant detached lunar disc, huge circular shield, bulky blade or axe attached to the bow. The weapon must remain long, agile and elegant rather than heavy or squat. Rich structural detail, polished sculpted contours, exquisite fantasy craft, controlled glow that does not erase the edges. No people, hands, sword, staff, extra weapon, alternate views, inset, collage, split panels, arrows, captions, letters, labels, watermark, ground scenery or background moon. Design direction: a flowing asymmetric recurve bow. The upper limb describes a long slender luminous blue crescent arc, continuously flowing into the grip and onward into a shorter reverse-curved lower limb. The crescent is part of the bow's graceful structural sweep, not an additional plate. One opening at the upper shoulder reveals a brilliant blue moonstone crescent; deep-cobalt outside surface, clear azure inner edge. Elegant open channel between two softly twisting structural ribs near the upper shoulder, merging into one sleek limb at the tip. Distinctive luxurious yet balanced moonlit silhouette, long and beautifully tapering.
